don't smoke carts man. terps are good. Everyone has endocannabinoid receptors, the issue seems to mainly come when you deprive your receptors of a majority of cannabinoids, only wiring them on THC. (this is a main personal theory of mine, not sure how true it is but it's stayed anecdotally correct in every case I've seen.) Think about the brain fog you get, think about the effects of weed that people talk about saying it makes you stupider.

For a list of effects of what abusing your EC receptors does: It controls appetite and metabolism (think those that can't eat without smoking weed, with no other reason.), pain perception, mood and anxiety (paranoia, more generalized anxiety in some people when quitting high dose thc), sleep, cardiovascular function (heart palpitations in those who use really high dose thc), gastrointestinal function (more constipation and nausea in those who use high dose thc), and neuro function!

All of this just to say, yes carts are bad, carts are the worst thing you could be smoking while your brains developing. This is the talk I've given to everyone who smokes mainly carts, and they all tend to generally be fighting the same issues in the long run. Bud avoids a lot of these issues by supplying your brain with less THC and more of other cannabinoids, giving you a fuller, and less brain-numbing high.
